description: Capabilities for the local boot UI, scoped to [local] only since the onboarding and error pages are served from the app's own protocol. `boot` covers the app's own probe/install/start commands: adding src-tauri/permissions/ created an app ACL manifest, which makes Tauri enforce the ACL for every app command — including these — so they must be granted explicitly rather than relying on the previous implicit allowance.
